{"type":"text","timestamp":1789888731632,"sessionID":"ses_f42517cd8ffed8E125izqBzTyn","part":{"id":"prt_0bdae85a4001UugG5hFSHXF7Tk","messageID":"msg_0bdae8337001BCe7mKR0nuqfkf","sessionID":"ses_f42517cd8ffed8E125izqBzTyn","type":"text","text":"import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import openai


@dataclass
class OnboardingSummary:
    user_id: str
    email: Optional[str]
    locale: Optional[str]
    account_status: str
    email_verified: bool
    profile_status: str
    password_reset_pending: bool
    last_activity_at: Optional[str]
    notes: List[str]
    support_flags: List[str]


def _env(key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    value = os.getenv(key, default)
    if value is None:
        return default
    return value


def _client() -> openai.OpenAI:
    return openai.OpenAI(api_key=_env("OPENAI_API_KEY"))


def _safe_str(value: Any) -> Optional[str]:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def summarize_onboarding_state(context: Dict[str, Any]) -> OnboardingSummary:
    user_id = _safe_str(context.get("user_id")) or "unknown"
    email = _safe_str(context.get("email"))
    locale = _safe_str(context.get("locale"))
    account_status = _safe_str(context.get("account_status")) or "unknown"
    email_verified = bool(context.get("email_verified", False))
    profile_status = _safe_str(context.get("profile_status")) or "unknown"
    password_reset_pending = bool(context.get("password_reset_pending", False))
    last_activity_at = _safe_str(context.get("last_activity_at"))

    notes_raw = context.get("notes", [])
    notes = []
    if isinstance(notes_raw, list):
        for note in notes_raw:
            text = _safe_str(note)
            if text:
                notes.append(text)

    support_flags = []
    if account_status.lower() in {"blocked", "disabled", "suspended"}:
        support_flags.append("account_restricted")
    if not email_verified:
        support_flags.append("email_unverified")
    if profile_status.lower() in {"incomplete", "rejected"}:
        support_flags.append("profile_needs_review")
    if password_reset_pending:
        support_flags.append("password_reset_pending")
    if last_activity_at:
        try:
            last_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_activity_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - last_dt > timezone.utc.utcoffset(datetime.now()) if timezone.utc.utcoffset(datetime.now()) else False:
                pass
        except Exception:
            support_flags.append("invalid_last_activity_timestamp")

    return OnboardingSummary(
        user_id=user_id,
        email=email,
        locale=locale,
        account_status=account_status,
        email_verified=email_verified,
        profile_status=profile_status,
        password_reset_pending=password_reset_pending,
        last_activity_at=last_activity_at,
        notes=notes,
        support_flags=support_flags,
    )


def summarize_onboarding_with_openai(context: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    summary = summarize_onboarding_state(context)
    client = _client()
    prompt = (
        "Summarize this onboarding state for support in one short paragraph:\n"
        f"user_id={summary.user_id}\n"
        f"email={summary.email}\n"
        f"locale={summary.locale}\n"
        f"account_status={summary.account_status}\n"
        f"email_verified={summary.email_verified}\n"
        f"profile_status={summary.profile_status}\n"
        f"password_reset_pending={summary.password_reset_pending}\n"
        f"last_activity_at={summary.last_activity_at}\n"
        f"notes={summary.notes}\n"
        f"support_flags={summary.support_flags}\n"
    )
    response = client.responses.create(
        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
        input=prompt,
    )
    return response.output_text","time":{"start":1789888726436,"end":1789888731631},"metadata":{"openai":{"itemId":"msg_05e444e16d82b519016aaf88d6711487d2b762c1d468988181","phase":"final_answer"}}}}
